description: Show how two symbols, files, or endpoints are connected across repos (names or URNs)

depth.description: How many hops to open inside the foreign repo after the first cross-source edge (not hops inside this checkout)

detail.description: compact (default) returns denser citations; full adds path/line/via endpoints

from.description: Source symbol, file, endpoint, or URN

includeLocal.description: When false (default), omit local-only nodes from the payload; keep foreign nodes plus local bridge call sites

scope.description: Anchor: repo = foreign graph around this checkout; tenant = whole workspace without requiring a local anchor

to.description: Destination symbol, file, endpoint, or URN

view.description: View identifier; defaults to tenant default view

name: gently_path
title: Connect two pieces of code
